issue.title: Never lose stashed prompts
issue.description: A pytest process can never read or mutate the user's real prompt stash or history, every row that permanently leaves the prompt stash is archived first and recoverable with `sase prompt stash-archive`, and the TUI's restore, stash-capture, and quit paths can no longer silently drop a prompt draft.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md requests this work

issue.title: Seal pytest home isolation and remove the stash-popping test bug
issue.description: seal-pytest-home: fix the monkeypatch.undo() test that popped the real stash, remove every undo() on the shared monkeypatch fixture, add an undo-proof session-level HOME/SASE_HOME sandbox, an AST guard test, a seal regression test, and SASE_HOME forwarding for tmux-launched TUIs.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase seal-pytest-home as one work unit

issue.title: Hard pytest boundary on the prompt stash and prompt history stores
issue.description: guard-prompt-stores: route every prompt_stash_facade read/mutation and every prompt-history write through assert_test_state_write_isolated so pytest can never touch the account's real prompts, with tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase guard-prompt-stores as one work unit

issue.title: sase-core append-only archive for every permanent stash removal
issue.description: core-stash-archive: in the linked sase-core repo, archive (fsynced, fail-closed, same lock) every popped, purged, evicted, and overwritten stash row before rewriting the stash; add read_prompt_stash_archive and recover_prompt_stash_archive bindings; fsync appends; tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase core-stash-archive as one work unit

issue.title: Restore and capture hardening in the TUI
issue.description: restore-capture-hardening: restore loads from the pop outcome with fail-closed reads and rollback, background stash-task failures are logged and toasted, failed stash appends put the draft back in the bar, and @/q/Q are unavailable while a prompt owns keys.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase restore-capture-hardening as one work unit

issue.title: Quitting the TUI stashes an open prompt draft
issue.description: quit-preserves-draft: generalize the pre-restart stash helper and call it on explicit quit paths (source=quit), cancel the exit if the stash write fails, mention the draft in the quit-confirm impact, with tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase quit-preserves-draft as one work unit

issue.title: Stash-archive recovery surface (CLI, TUI hints, docs) and core pin
issue.description: stash-archive-recovery: bump the sase-core pin, add guarded archive facade functions, the sase prompt stash-archive list/restore/show CLI, archive hints in purge/evict/delete toasts, docs, and tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/never_lose_stashed_prompts.md defines phase stash-archive-recovery as one work unit
